title: Months Released When a Disability Compensation Suspension Ends: Returned and Replaced Payments
content:
**Rule.** The months a Disability Compensation resumption release covers are set by the award's returned and replaced payments:

| Payment history shows | Months covered |
|---|---|
| Monthly payments came back and none of them has a replacement | The payments that came back plus the whole months elapsed from the most recent monthly payment's issue date to today |
| Monthly payments came back and some of them have a replacement | The payments that came back less those replaced, plus those whole months |
| No monthly payment came back | Those whole months alone |

The payments that came back are the returned-payment entries on the award; those replaced are the replacement entries on the award.

**Input — judgement — output (hypothetical; most recent monthly payment issued 1 May 2026, today 15 September 2026, so 4 whole months)**

1. Two payments came back, none replaced: 2 plus 4, that is 6 months.
2. Two payments came back, one replaced: 2 less 1 plus 4, that is 5 months.
3. No payment came back: 4 months.
